title: SHA-256 File Hash
description: Calculate a SHA-256 checksum for a local file.
code:
import hashlib

path = 'sample.txt'
h = hashlib.sha256()
with open(path, 'rb') as f:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b''):
        h.update(chunk)
print(h.hexdigest())

title: Password Strength Checker
description: Check basic password characteristics locally; this does not test a login.
code:
import re

password = input('Test password: ')
checks = {
    '12+ characters': len(password) >= 12,
    'Uppercase': bool(re.search(r'[A-Z]', password)),
    'Lowercase': bool(re.search(r'[a-z]', password)),
    'Number': bool(re.search(r'[0-9]', password)),
    'Symbol': bool(re.search(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', password)),
}
for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(f'{name}: {"PASS" if ok else "FAIL"}')

title: Check TLS Certificate Expiry
description: Read the TLS certificate for a host you own or are authorized to inspect.
code:
import socket, ssl
from datetime import datetime, timezone

host = 'example.com'
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
with socket.create_connection((host, 443), timeout=5) as raw:
    with ctx.wrap_socket(raw, server_hostname=host) as tls:
        cert = tls.getpeercert()
expiry = datetime.strptime(cert['notAfter'], '%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
print('Certificate expires:', expiry)
print('Days remaining:', (expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days)

title: Create a File Integrity Manifest
description: Hash files in a folder to help detect unexpected changes.
code:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

root = Path('test-folder')
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if path.is_file():
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        print(digest, path)

title: Verify a File Against Its SHA-256
description: Compare a downloaded file with a trusted checksum supplied by its publisher.
code:
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

file_path = Path('download.zip')
expected = 'PASTE_TRUSTED_SHA256_HERE'.lower()
actual = hashlib.sha256(file_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('MATCH' if actual == expected else 'MISMATCH')

title: Safe SQLite Parameterized Query
description: Use placeholders rather than string concatenation to prevent SQL injection.
code:
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE users (username TEXT)')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES (?)', ('alice',))
name = input('Username to find: ')
row = conn.execute('SELECT username FROM users WHERE username = ?', (name,)).fetchone()
print(row)
conn.close()

title: Hash a Password with PBKDF2
description: Demonstrate salted password hashing for learning; use Argon2id or scrypt in production where available.
code:
import os, hashlib, base64

password = 'Example-Only-Password!'
salt = os.urandom(16)
dk = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', password.encode(), salt, 600_000)
print('salt:', base64.b64encode(salt).decode())
print('hash:', base64.b64encode(dk).decode())

title: Parse a Web Server Access Log
description: Count HTTP status codes in a local log file.
code:
from collections import Counter

counts = Counter()
with open('access.log', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) > 8 and parts[8].isdigit():
            counts[parts[8]] += 1
print(counts)

title: Calculate a Subnet Network
description: Learn network address, broadcast address and usable host count.
code:
import ipaddress

net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.1.10/24', strict=False)
print('Network:', net.network_address)
print('Broadcast:', net.broadcast_address)
print('Prefix:', net.prefixlen)
print('Usable hosts:', max(net.num_addresses - 2, 0))

title: Simple JSON API Input Validation
description: Validate expected JSON fields and types before processing API input.
code:
def validate_user_payload(data):
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return False
    username = data.get('username')
    age = data.get('age')
    return (isinstance(username, str) and 1 <= len(username) <= 30
            and isinstance(age, int) and not isinstance(age, bool)
            and 0 <= age <= 120)

print(validate_user_payload({'username': 'alice', 'age': 25}))
